summary: This bill authorizes the President to grant permanent normal trade relations status to Kazakhstan, thereby ending the application of the Jackson-Vanik amendment to that country.

scores.thoughts: This bill is entirely focused on authorizing the extension of normal trade relations treatment to Kazakhstan, which is a move towards reducing trade barriers and promoting free trade. It explicitly aims to terminate the application of Title IV of the Trade Act of 1974, which imposes conditions on trade with non-market economies.
